app.name: FinPilot AI
sidebar.language_help: Switch the whole interface between French and English.
sidebar.data_mode_help: Demo mode uses reproducible SIMULATED prices and works offline. Historical mode downloads real prices from the provider.
sidebar.market_help: US market data comes from yfinance. Moroccan market data requires a CSV import (Settings) or Demo mode.
sidebar.help_body:
1. Pick a market and a data mode.
2. Build your portfolio in **Portfolio Builder**.
3. Explore performance, risk, optimization and stress tests.
4. Ask the AI assistant to explain any metric.
sidebar.disclaimer_body: FinPilot AI is an **educational** project. It never executes trades, stores money or promises returns. All metrics are historical or hypothetical — not investment advice.
common.name: Name
dashboard.subtitle: Overview of your portfolio: allocation, performance, risk and data provenance.
dashboard.empty_hint: Your portfolio is empty or invalid. Open the **Portfolio Builder** to add assets and weights.
dashboard.no_benchmark: No benchmark selected for this market.
kpi.unavailable: No metrics available for this portfolio.
bench.label: Benchmark ({ticker})
bench.unavailable: No benchmark data available for the selected period.
warn.simulated_data: SIMULATED DATA — Demo mode generates synthetic prices. They are not real market observations.
warn.multi_currency: This portfolio mixes USD and MAD. Totals are reported per currency because no explicit FX rate is configured. Add a rate in Settings to combine them.
builder.subtitle: Select assets, set weights and choose the analysis period. Every other page uses this portfolio.
builder.capital_help: Starting capital used for all monetary figures.
builder.weights_valid: Weights total 100 % — the portfolio is valid.
builder.weights_invalid: Weights must total exactly 100 % before analytics can run (currently {total} %).
builder.no_benchmark: No benchmark available for this market and data mode.
builder.empty_universe: No instrument is available for this market and data mode. Import a CSV in Settings or switch to Demo mode.
builder.ma_hint: Moroccan instruments are not bundled: no verified Casablanca data feed is included. Import your own CSV of historical prices in **Settings**, or use Demo mode (simulated baskets).
builder.saved: Portfolio applied. All analytics pages now use it.
builder.reset_done: Portfolio reset to the market defaults.
builder.empty: Add at least one asset to build your portfolio.
builder.start_first: Add assets with the selector above, assign weights, then press **Apply**.
perf.subtitle: Historical performance of the portfolio: wealth path, cumulative return, monthly returns and drawdown.
perf.monthly_note: Monthly returns are compounded from daily returns within each calendar month.
perf.no_benchmark: Select a benchmark in the Portfolio Builder to compare performance.
risk.subtitle: Risk metrics, correlation structure and diversification of the portfolio.
risk.risk_contrib_note: Each asset's contribution to total portfolio risk. Concentration of risk can differ greatly from concentration of capital.
risk.single_asset_note: A single-asset portfolio has no measurable diversification: its effective number of assets is 1.
risk.no_correlation: Correlation requires at least two assets with overlapping observations.
opt.subtitle: Compare your current allocation with long-only historical optimizations (minimum volatility / maximum Sharpe).
opt.max_weight_help: Long-only constraint: no asset may exceed this weight.
opt.disclaimer: Optimization is **historical**, based on estimated means and a sample covariance matrix under strong assumptions. It does **not** guarantee better future performance and is not investment advice.
opt.need_valid: A valid portfolio with at least two assets is required before optimizing.
opt.hint: Press **Run optimization** to compute the efficient-frontier solutions on the selected period.
stress.subtitle: Apply hypothetical shocks to assets or asset groups and estimate the impact on your portfolio.
stress.shock_help: Negative = loss, positive = gain. Example: -10 for a 10 % fall.
stress.hypothetical: HYPOTHETICAL SCENARIO — a first-order estimate assuming instantaneous, simultaneous shocks with no rebalancing. This is not a forecast.
stress.no_shocks: Define at least one shock (preset, asset-class or per-asset) before running the scenario.
stress.empty: The scenario does not affect any asset in the portfolio.
ai.subtitle: Ask the assistant to explain any metric. Python computes every number — the model only explains them.
ai.not_configured: No AI key configured. Set LLM_API_KEY in a .env file (see .env.example) to enable the assistant. Everything else works without it.
ai.configure_hint: Copy .env.example to .env and fill in LLM_API_KEY, then restart the app.
ai.input_hint: Ask a question about your portfolio…
ai.no_portfolio: No computed portfolio yet — open the Dashboard or Portfolio Builder first so the assistant has real numbers to explain.
ai.answered_by: Answer generated by the configured LLM from the application's calculated results.
ai.privacy_note: Only aggregated portfolio results are sent to the model — never your API key, never raw credentials.
settings.subtitle: Configuration: data import, risk-free rate, FX rate and assistant credentials.
settings.risk_free_help: Used for the Sharpe ratio. Default 2 %.
settings.fx_help: USD/MAD totals are only combined when you provide a rate here or in the FX_USD_MAD environment variable. Without it, totals stay separate per currency.
settings.fx_saved: FX rate saved. Multi-currency totals are now combined.
settings.fx_cleared: FX rate cleared. Totals are reported per currency.
settings.csv_help: Import historical closing prices: either a **wide** CSV (date, TICKER1, TICKER2…) or a **long** CSV (date, ticker, price). Values are validated; nothing is forward-filled.
settings.reset_done: Session reset. Reload the page to start fresh.
settings.debug_help: Local debugging only — keep it off in normal use.
settings.imported_assets: Assets available from the imported CSV
code.no_assets: The portfolio is empty. Add at least one asset.
code.duplicate_assets: The same ticker appears several times in the portfolio.
code.empty_weights: All weights are zero — nothing to analyse.
code.invalid_capital: The initial capital must be a positive number.
code.invalid_date_range: The end date must not be before the start date.
code.missing_prices: No historical prices are available for these assets
code.insufficient_history: Not enough historical observations in the selected period.
code.portfolio_calculation_failed: Portfolio metrics could not be computed with the current data.
code.dropped_dates: Dates with incomplete prices were excluded (no values were filled in)
code.fx_missing: No explicit FX rate: totals are shown per currency and never mixed.
code.benchmark_simulated: The benchmark series is simulated (Demo mode).
code.benchmark_overlap: Not enough overlapping observations with the benchmark
code.correlation_unavailable: Correlation could not be computed for this portfolio.
code.short_history: Short history — annualized statistics are unreliable
error.generic: Something went wrong while computing this page. Try changing the period or the data mode.
